items.title: Customer Data Cleaning & Standardization
items.shortDescription: Cleaned and standardized a sample customer dataset of about 5,250 records.
items.description: Cleaned and standardized a sample customer dataset containing approximately 5,250 records.
items.disclosure: This is a self-initiated demo project built on a sample dataset. It is not client work.
items.problem: Raw customer data is rarely ready to use. Records repeat, names, phone numbers, cities and dates follow different formats, and some emails or values are invalid or missing. That makes the data hard to filter, count or report on.
items.objective: Turn the raw file into one consistent dataset that can be filtered, summarized and reused, with every problem record clearly identified.

process.title: Review the raw file
process.description: Look through the raw data to find the formatting problems, repeated records and gaps.

process.title: Standardize the fields
process.description: Make names, phone numbers, emails, cities and dates follow one consistent format.

process.title: Identify problem records
process.description: Find duplicates, invalid emails and missing values.

process.title: Classify and summarize
process.description: Add a Data_Status value to each record and report the summary metrics.

results: A cleaned customer dataset with standardized names, phone numbers, emails, cities and dates
Invalid emails and missing values identified
A Data_Status value for every record
A summary of the cleaning metrics
